apps.subtitle: Run AI coding agents on your own machines: a local daemon, a relay gateway, and native macOS, iOS and Android clients
apps.localizedDescription:
Dieter is a workspace for coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Oh My Pi and DeepSeek Harness) that run on your own machines. A small daemon starts each agent beside your Git checkout, with your tools and your provider accounts, and keeps it running when you close the app or put your laptop to sleep. Native apps bring every machine's boards, conversations, files, terminals and screens into one place, so you can start a task on your Mac, let a Linux workstation do it, and review the result from your phone.

• Many machines, one project. Check out the same project on several hosts; each conversation runs on the machine you choose.
• Review in place. Files, Git changes, terminals, background processes and an authenticated remote screen, next to the conversation.
